reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A required central exit stair connects four or more storeys, but the architect specifies only 1-hour protected-exit separation. Is this compliant under RA 9514?

options.text: Yes, because 1-hour is enough for all protected exits
Yes, if the building is an office
No, four or more storeys require at least 2-hour fire resistance
No, all protected exits require 4-hour separation

proposed.rationale: RA 9514 Section 10.2.5.2(B) requires at least two-hour fire resistance where a protected exit connects four or more storeys.
proposed.explanation: This keeps the original issue but cites the checked source precisely.
